authenticity_review: The image exhibits critical structural and semantic failures. 1) Scale/Perspective Distortion (Severity 3): The bird is rendered at a giant scale relative to the trucks, creating a physically impossible surreal scene where a small songbird appears larger than a truck cab. 2) Taxonomy Mismatch: The system taxonomy specifies 'cock' (rooster), but the image shows a passerine (warbler/sparrow) lacking comb, wattles, iridescent plumage, and spurs. All bird checkpoints fail. 3) Vehicle Type Mismatch: System taxonomy specifies 'pickup', but image shows heavy-duty semi-trucks with enclosed trailers. All truck checkpoints fail. 4) Spatial Failure: Bird is on top instead of under. Despite high rendering quality of individual elements, these fundamental mismatches result in low authenticity.
key_defects: Spatial relationship inversion (bird on top instead of under)
Severe scale distortion (giant bird relative to trucks)
Taxonomy mismatch (passerine bird instead of cock/rooster)
Vehicle type mismatch (semi-trucks instead of pickups)
